# Land database: schema, rules and update procedure

> Part of a personal portfolio desk study on public data (AI-assisted; not affiliated with LTA, SLA or URA).
> The corridor is fictional. Statuses, dates and documents in the demo database are SYNTHETIC.

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_docs.py from corridor/landdb.py, corridor/screening.py and results/landdb.json. -->

File: `outputs/land_db.gpkg` (GeoPackage, EPSG:3414). Two spatial layers hold geometry; the other tables are
GeoPackage attribute tables with explicit column types, unique keys and foreign keys (checked with
`PRAGMA foreign_key_check` when the file is written). Each table also has the integer `fid` key GeoPackage expects.

## Spatial layers

### `parcels`

Cadastral lots in the study area with land use and the State-land indicator.

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `lot_key` | TEXT, unique | SLA lot key (mukim or town subdivision, lot number); identifier only |
| `lot_area_m2` | REAL | Plan area of the lot polygon (SVY21), not the title area |
| `land_use` | TEXT | Master Plan 2025 zone covering the largest share of the lot |
| `land_use_share` | REAL | Share of the lot under that zone |
| `state_land_share` | REAL | Share of the lot covered by SLA's open State-land layers |
| `state_land_indicated` | INTEGER 0/1 | 1 when that share is at least one half |
| `tenure_evidence` | TEXT | What the open data say about tenure |
| `source` | TEXT | Origin of the geometry |
| `geometry` | POLYGON / MULTIPOLYGON, EPSG:3414 | Lot boundary as published (approximate) |

### `affected_areas`

Pieces of each footprint component in each lot, per alignment version.

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `area_id` | TEXT, unique | version:component:lot:n |
| `version_id` | TEXT | Alignment version |
| `component_id` | TEXT | Box, tunnel or worksite |
| `component_type` | TEXT | station_box, bored_tunnel or worksite |
| `take` | TEXT | permanent_surface, permanent_subterranean or temporary_surface |
| `lot_key` | TEXT | Lot |
| `area_m2` | REAL | Plan area of the piece |
| `geometry` | POLYGON / MULTIPOLYGON, EPSG:3414 | The piece |

## Attribute tables

### `alignment_versions`

Each alignment variant or revision the database has seen.

| Column | Type and constraint | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version_id` | TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE | e.g. A-v1 |
| `variant` | TEXT NOT NULL | Variant key |
| `label` | TEXT | Description |
| `pis_json` | TEXT NOT NULL | Points of intersection, SVY21 |
| `geometry_sha` | TEXT NOT NULL | Hash of the PIs |
| `status` | TEXT NOT NULL | baseline, option, revision or superseded |
| `created` | TEXT | Date stamped on the record |

### `interests`

Land interest needed in a lot for one alignment version.

| Column | Type and constraint | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `interest_id` | TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE | version:lot:instrument |
| `version_id` | TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES alignment_versions(version_id) | Alignment version |
| `lot_key` | TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parcels(lot_key) | Lot |
| `interest_type` | TEXT NOT NULL | permanent_surface, permanent_subterranean, temporary_surface or zone |
| `instrument_code` | TEXT NOT NULL | Mechanism code (see README) |
| `instrument_text` | TEXT | Mechanism in words |
| `agency` | TEXT | Agency to liaise with, per the public sources |
| `area_m2` | REAL NOT NULL | Plan area |
| `stratum_top_m_shd` | REAL | Top of a subterranean stratum, m SHD |
| `stratum_bottom_m_shd` | REAL | Bottom of a subterranean stratum, m SHD |
| `status` | TEXT NOT NULL | proposed, superseded or withdrawn |
| `start_date` | TEXT | Start of temporary occupation (SYNTHETIC) |
| `end_date` | TEXT | End of temporary occupation (SYNTHETIC) |
| `created` | TEXT | Date stamped on the record |
| `updated` | TEXT | Date of the last change |

### `steps`

Status of each acquisition or occupation step of an interest.

| Column | Type and constraint | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `step_id` | TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE | interest:seq |
| `interest_id` | TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES interests(interest_id) | Interest |
| `seq` | INTEGER NOT NULL | Order |
| `step_name` | TEXT NOT NULL | Step |
| `source` | TEXT NOT NULL | Fact-sheet row the step comes from, or ILLUSTRATIVE |
| `mandatory` | INTEGER NOT NULL | 1 if the step cannot be skipped |
| `status` | TEXT NOT NULL | not_started, in_progress, done, not_applicable or withdrawn |
| `date` | TEXT | Date of the status (SYNTHETIC) |
| `note` | TEXT | Note |

### `documents`

Documents to obtain or held for an interest (SYNTHETIC placeholders).

| Column | Type and constraint | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `doc_id` | TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE | Identifier |
| `interest_id` | TEXT REFERENCES interests(interest_id) | Interest |
| `lot_key` | TEXT REFERENCES parcels(lot_key) | Lot |
| `doc_type` | TEXT NOT NULL | Kind of document |
| `title` | TEXT | Title |
| `status` | TEXT NOT NULL | to_obtain, received or not_applicable |
| `reference` | TEXT | Reference |
| `date` | TEXT | Date |
| `note` | TEXT | Note |

### `change_log`

Every change made after the first load, with the reason.

| Column | Type and constraint | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `change_id` | INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE | Sequence |
| `timestamp` | TEXT NOT NULL | Date stamped on the change |

| `record_id` | TEXT NOT NULL | Record |
| `field` | TEXT NOT NULL | Field |

| `new_value` | TEXT | After |
| `reason` | TEXT | Why |

### `validation_rules`

Rules checked by corridor.landdb.LandDB.validate().

| Column | Type and constraint | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `rule_id` | TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE | Rule |

### `metadata`

| Column | Type and constraint | Meaning |

| `value` | TEXT | Value |

## Instrument codes

Route each interest to the public mechanism in the fact sheet. The State-land indicator comes from SLA's open layers only, so every route says what must be confirmed.

| Code | Take | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ACQ-SURFACE` | permanent_surface | If not State land: acquisition by declaration under s.5 Land Acquisition Act (whole or part lot). Confirm tenure with SLA first |
| `STATE-SURFACE` | permanent_surface | Shown as State land: no acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act; arrangement with SLA (the process is not described in the public sources used) |
| `ACQ-STRATUM` | permanent_subterranean | If not State land: subterranean stratum only, s.5(1A) Land Acquisition Act; the tunnel lies above the default ownership depth MinLaw described. Confirm tenure and the depth stated in the State title with SLA |
| `CHECK-TITLE` | permanent_subterranean | The tunnel lies below the default ownership depth MinLaw described: confirm the depth in the State title before assuming no acquisition is needed |
| `STATE-STRATUM` | permanent_subterranean | Shown as State land: no acquisition of the stratum |
| `TEMP-OCC` | temporary_surface | If not State land: temporary occupation under s.42 Land Acquisition Act (ordinarily up to 3 continuous years); if State land: TOL. Confirm tenure with SLA |
| `TOL` | temporary_surface | Temporary Occupation Licence over State land (State Lands Rules r.19) |
| `RAIL-ZONE` | zone | Within the railway corridor / protection distances of the structure: development and works controls administered by LTA (Development & Building Control (Rail)) |

## Steps tracked for each instrument

Source: a fact-sheet row (VERIFIED) or ILLUSTRATIVE (the author's checklist). Optional steps are in italics.

| Instrument | Steps (source) |
|---|---|
| `ACQ-SURFACE` | Confirm tenure and title particulars (lot search) (ILLUSTRATIVE); Notice of acquisition (F06); Collector's inquiry (F06); Collector's award (F06); Payment of compensation and site possession (F06); *Appeal to the Appeals Board (if lodged) (F06)* |
| `ACQ-STRATUM` | Confirm tenure and the depth stated in the State title (ILLUSTRATIVE); Define the stratum (plan and levels) (ILLUSTRATIVE); Notice of acquisition (F06); Collector's inquiry (F06); Collector's award (F06); Payment of compensation and site possession (F06); *Appeal to the Appeals Board (if lodged) (F06)* |
| `TEMP-OCC` | Confirm the land is not State land (ILLUSTRATIVE); Notice to interested persons and occupiers (at least one month) (F10); Temporary possession (F10); Return of the land at the end of the term (ILLUSTRATIVE); *Compensation claims settled (ILLUSTRATIVE)* |
| `TOL` | Confirm the land is State land (ILLUSTRATIVE); Apply for a Temporary Occupation Licence (F09); Licence issued (F08); Licence ends and site handed back (ILLUSTRATIVE) |
| `STATE-SURFACE` | Confirm State land and agree the arrangement with SLA (ILLUSTRATIVE) |
| `STATE-STRATUM` | Confirm State land and agree the arrangement with SLA (ILLUSTRATIVE) |
| `CHECK-TITLE` | Confirm the depth stated in the State title (ILLUSTRATIVE) |
| `RAIL-ZONE` | Record the lot as within the protection distances (ILLUSTRATIVE); *Track the gazette of the railway area (F16)* |

## Validation rules

| Rule | Check | Severity |
|---|---|---|
| V01 | Primary keys are unique in every table | error |
| V02 | Every interest and affected area refers to an existing parcel | error |
| V03 | Every interest and affected area refers to an existing alignment version | error |
| V04 | Interest area is positive and not larger than the parcel | error |
| V05 | Surface take (permanent plus temporary) on a lot does not exceed the lot area in any version | error |
| V06 | Temporary occupation under s.42 runs no longer than the fact-sheet limit; TOLs under 10 years | error |
| V07 | Instrument agrees with the tenure indicator (TOL only on land shown as State land; s.42 only on land not shown as State land) | error |
| V08 | A stratum has its top above its bottom | error |
| V09 | Steps: a mandatory step is not done while an earlier mandatory step is not done; withdrawn interests have no step in progress | error |
| V10 | Documents refer to an existing interest or parcel | error |
| V11 | Geometries are valid, not empty and in EPSG:3414 | error |
| V12 | Interest area equals the sum of its affected-area pieces | error |

## How an alignment change is applied

`LandDB.revise(base, new, ...)` adds the revised alignment as a new version, marks the base `superseded`,
recomputes the affected areas and interests, and reconciles them lot by lot:

- **Out of scope** (an interest in the base, none in the new version): the interest becomes `withdrawn`;
  its steps not yet done become `withdrawn`; steps already done are kept and flagged
  `completed before revision: review`.
- **New in scope**: new interests with every step `not_started`.
- **Continuing** (same lot and take type): the area change is logged when it exceeds 1 square metre or the
  instrument changes; progress already made is carried over to the new interest when the instrument is the
  same, and the old interest becomes `superseded`.
- Every change is written to `change_log` with the version that caused it and the reason.

## Demo in the committed database

The database holds 4 alignment versions (452 interests,
1665 steps, 272 document placeholders). SYNTHETIC progress was recorded on
the baseline A-v1, then the alignment was revised to
A-v2 (A rev 1: north end moved 40 m east). Result:
11 interests moved out of scope, 11 came into scope,
89 continuing interests changed area or instrument, and
1 completed steps were flagged for review. The change log has
123 entries. All 12 validation rules pass on the committed file
(0 failures); `tests/test_landdb.py` plants an error for each rule and checks that it is caught.

Lots that moved out of scope: MK28-01466P (permanent subterranean), MK28-01837T (permanent subterranean), MK28-01856K (zone), MK28-01857N (zone), MK28-02679A (permanent surface), MK28-04686A (permanent subterranean), MK28-06278X (permanent subterranean), MK28-07167W (temporary surface), MK28-07176N (zone), MK28-07443N (zone), MK28-07824T (zone).
Lots that came into scope: MK28-01463M (permanent subterranean), MK28-01464W (permanent subterranean), MK28-01624M (permanent subterranean), MK28-02524W (zone), MK28-03894K (zone), MK28-06844L (zone), MK28-06901X (zone), MK28-06902L (zone), MK28-07170W (zone), MK28-07171V (zone), MK28-07501N (zone).
